meta.confidence: Inferred: column AH's reward icon is a castle/building silhouette badge with a '+' (an instant-construction token, per standard Goodgame Empire iconography), appearing at every box tier. Less certain than the rubies identification, since this icon doesn't print a literal token count the way the ruby icon prints its ruby amount.
meta.caveat: Treat this series as a good-faith reconstruction rather than a confirmed 1:1 mapping; the badge number visible on the icon looks like a building-level indicator, not a reward quantity, so it was not used as an amount multiplier.
